marius-cust: Hi — trying to upload a resale cert and enable reverse charge for invoice 2026-045 but the billing UI says my VAT ID is invalid (DE 123456789). Can someone advise?

lina-support: Hey @marius-cust — sorry about the friction. Quick Qs: did you enter the VAT ID with spaces or any punctuation? UI wants the standard format (no spaces). Also, can you paste the exact string you used or a screenshot?

marius-cust: Screenshot attached in the portal — it shows `VAT ID format invalid`. I pasted `DE 123456789` with a space (we copy-pasted from our ERP). Our legal name is "Marius Logistics GmbH" and VAT in VIES shows active.

lina-support: OK that explains it — our validator strips non-alphanumerics but spaces can trigger the client-side check. Try this normalized form: `DE123456789` (no spaces). If that still fails, we can validate via VIES and escalate for a manual exemption.

marius-cust: Tried `DE123456789` — still getting the same error. Screenshot: "VAT ID could not be verified (VIES returned no record)". We double-checked VIES separately and it shows the VAT as valid.

lina-support: Thanks. Two options: 1) I can open a manual exemption request with Billing — they'll need a copy of your EU VAT certificate / resale cert + a screenshot of the VIES confirmation. 2) If you prefer faster self-service, try the alternate country prefix (some German IDs include leading zeros) but usually manual review is needed when our VIES check times out or returns inconsistent metadata.

billing-bot: Manual exemption request received — ticket #BILL-2026-872. Please upload the VAT certificate PDF to the secure billing portal or reply here with the support URL.

marius-cust: Uploaded PDF (company registration + VAT certificate) and attached the VIES result. Also added PO# PO-8891 to the invoice. Appreciate the help.

olga-billing: Hi @marius-cust — Olga from Billing. I have ticket BILL-2026-872. Quick checklist before we can apply reverse-charge: 1) VAT number must match legal entity name on the certificate, 2) billing country must be DE (Germany), 3) PO present if required for your accounting. Can you confirm legal entity match and the billing address?

marius-cust: Confirmed — legal entity and address match. PO present as noted. One question: if you apply reverse charge now, will the invoice be reissued or only a credit memo applied? We need the document that shows 0% VAT for our auditors.

olga-billing: Good Q. We typically issue a corrected invoice showing reverse charge (0% VAT) once the manual review completes. That will take 3-5 business days. If the original payment was processed and VAT was charged, we issue a credit note and a new invoice. Please note refunds/credits can be delayed if payment method is a card and issuer holds funds.

marius-cust: Understood. Any chance to expedite? Our auditors are pressing.

olga-billing: I'll mark this as high priority. One last item: because our automated VIES check failed, we need either (a) the VIES confirmation screenshot showing the VAT number and entity, or (b) the national tax authority PDF for Germany. You already uploaded the VAT cert, but the VIES screenshot helps speed approval.

marius-cust: Uploaded VIES screenshot now. Thanks.

lina-support: Thanks all — I'll keep an eye on BILL-2026-872. If billing needs a manual override in the portal, @olga-billing will run it and confirm here. :thumbsup:

olga-billing: Got it. Manual override queued — target ETA 72 hours. I'll post back when the corrected invoice is published. :white_check_mark:

marius-cust: Appreciate it, team. One more thing — our finance asked if reverse charge can be backdated to invoice date (2026-03-29). Is that supported?

olga-billing: We can backdate the tax treatment to the original invoice date for accounting purposes, yes. We'll reflect that on the corrected invoice. I'll confirm once completed.

marius-cust: Perfect. Thanks everyone. :pray:
